text:
acme_prod_ops: We started seeing a spike of 503/504 from the hosted API around 09:12 UTC. SDK is retrying in a tight loop and customers are seeing failures. sample request id: req_6f3a2c, region=eu-west1, model=redwood-7b-v2. Can someone triage?

maya_support: Sorry about that — digging in now. Can you paste the SDK version + any client logs you have?

acme_prod_ops: SDK v0.9.1, logs show repeated 503 then immediate retry. Example curl we run for repro:```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "X-Request-ID: req_6f3a2c" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-v2","input":"test"}'```

deploy-bot: deploy: redwood-runtime v7.2.3 -> edge-proxy updated at 09:08 UTC (config: keepalive_timeout=30s)

eli_oncall: Looking at edge logs — I see repeated upstream ECONNRESET and then 502/503 for long-lived streaming requests. Connection reuse + aggressive keepalive eviction looks suspicious. Quick repro: curl with --http2 and small keepalive triggers resets. Example repro:```# repro (unix)
curl --http2 --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  --header "X-Request-ID: test-repro-1" \
  --data '{"model":"redwood-7b-v2","input":"x"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
``` Also seeing client SDK open sockets then retry immediately, causing connection storm.

priya_infra: We throttled the tenant briefly because connection queue spiked and autoscaler lagged. I'm going to bump per-tenant conn limit + disable the new keepalive change on edge for 5m rollback. Rolling change in ~3m.

maya_support: For customers: please set client timeouts to 60s and backoff (max_retries=3, backoff_factor=1.5) to avoid tight retry storms. Sample python patch:```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=KEY, timeout=60, max_retries=3, backoff_factor=1.5)
resp = client.generate(...)
```

acme_prod_ops: Thanks. One concern — will retries during the outage cause double billing for tokens?

jordan_account: We'll pause billing for the impacted window and follow up with credits. Gathering exact request ids and minutes now. :white_check_mark:

priya_infra: Change rolled out at 09:21 UTC (conn_limit -> 200, edge keepalive reverted). Metrics: error rate for tenant dropped from ~12% to ~1% in 3m. Watching CPU and queue depth.

acme_prod_ops: Confirming on our side — errors dropped and retries tapered off. We'll run load test and report if we see regressions. Thanks team.

maya_support: Closing loop for now — tagging for postmortem as incident-1823456789. We'll share RCA and mitigation notes (client guidance + edge config) when ready. :thumbsup:

eli_oncall: Adding notes for RCA: root cause looks like an edge keepalive timeout + new config -> idle eviction while streams still in-flight; combined with immediate retry behavior on client caused connection storm and throttle. Next: add safer defaults in SDK and gradual rollout of edge keepalive.

acme_prod_ops: Appreciated. Please include steps we can use to repro locally and recommended SDK patch.

maya_support: Will attach repro steps + minimal python repro and timeline in the postmortem.
